query:
SELECT s.id as student_id, s.name, ss.id as ss_id, ss.sessionId, ss.absent, ses.status, ses.problemNumber, ses.sessionNumber,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluations e WHERE e.sessionId = ss.sessionId) as total_evaluations,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_items ei JOIN evaluations e ON ei.evaluationId = e.id WHERE e.sessionId = ss.sessionId AND ei.evaluatedStudentId = ss.id) as evals_received
FROM students s 
JOIN session_students ss ON s.id = ss.studentId
JOIN sessions ses ON ss.sessionId = ses.id
WHERE s.enrollment = '23211323';
